title: Photon: Fault-tolerant and Scalable Joining of Continuous Data Streams
authors: Rajagopal Ananthanarayanan, Venkatesh Basker, Sumit Das, Ashish Gupta, Haifeng Jiang, Tianhao Qiu, Alexey Reznichenko, Deomid Ryabkov, Manpreet Singh, Shivakumar Venkataraman
description: Photon is Google's geographically-distributed stream-joining system that achieves exactly-once semantics for joining ad click events with query events using a Paxos-based IdRegistry as the coordination backbone.
